title: Agentic AI Systems Design — Live Intensive

competencies.text: Implement a bounded agent with validated tools, scoped memory and termination tests.
Measure retrieval quality and trace each supported answer to evidence.
Compare coordination designs under failed tools, missing context and withheld approval.
Evaluate reliability, privacy and cost using reproducible tests and observable traces.
Deliver and defend a documented system with explicit limitations and human decision authority.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate establish a measurable agent baseline with reproducible evidence.
Explain one failure, one limitation and the human approval boundary.

activity.student: For establish a measurable agent baseline, define a synthetic scenario; build or model a bounded solution; record outputs and failed tests. Submit a 2–3-page APA-style Word/PDF report with code excerpts or diagrams, evidence and references. Proposed deadline: Sunday 11:59 PM in the published cohort time zone; no cohort dates configured.
activity.instructor: Review establish a measurable agent baseline for reproducibility, evidence quality and safe boundaries. Check baseline comparability, withheld approval and unsupported claims. A specific worked solution and calibrated scoring guide are still required.

stretch.title: Compare strict and permissive tool schemas

capstone: Choose a synthetic Academy support, research-evidence or permission-scoped code-review scenario. Build an end-to-end agent system and defend it in a ten-minute presentation. No external institution integration is authorized.
researchMemo: Choose a verified public research paper. Identify its question, method and limitations, then compare one design choice in your capstone against its evidence. Include an original discussion question and complete citation. Publication is blocked until faculty verifies authors, year, venue and source.
schedule: Weeks 1–6: proposed live discussion and two 90-minute labs. Weeks 7–10: reliability, research, capstone clinics and defense. No dates, times, seats or recording availability have been published.
funding: Non-credit professional training. No approval for federal student aid or military education benefits is recorded. Accepted payment methods are unconfigured.
dependencyNotes: Ten-week adaptation supersedes the source seven-week pacing. Transfer, late-enrollment deadline extensions, access duration and issue timing require approved policy.
gaps: Executed twelve domain labs and data cards
Six quiz banks and pass/cooldown implementation
Verified research citations and maintained tool/version licenses
Live calendar, time-zone display, recordings and support contacts
Approved capstone threshold, access period, issue timing and finance policies
